overview: Low-level farm bird ideal for initial level 1-10 combat training.

methods.title: Beginner Melee Training
methods.whyThisWorks: Low defence and 3 HP allows players to rapid-hit and level up early Attack and Strength.

overview: Excellent source of raw beef, cowhides, and level 5-20 combat experience.

methods.title: Beginner Melee Training
methods.whyThisWorks: Fast attacks with slash weapons quickly clear cows for hides and bones.

overview: Classic beginner humanoid monster. Drops beginner clue scrolls.

methods.title: Beginner Scimitar Slicing
methods.whyThisWorks: Fast 4-tick weapons one-shot low HP goblins.

overview: Standard urban guards. Popular for Medium Clue scroll hunting with Falador Medium Diary.

methods.title: Falador Guard Clue Hunting
methods.whyThisWorks: Dragon scimitar provides high DPS to speed up medium clue drops (1/106 with Falador Diary).

overview: Iconic mid-level monster dropping Big bones and Giant keys to fight Obor. Has a distinct crush weakness.

methods.title: Crush Melee (Giant Key Farming)
methods.whyThisWorks: Hill Giants possess a -10 crush defence penalty. Dragon mace + Dragon defender shreds them.

methods.title: Safespot Ranged
methods.whyThisWorks: Safespots behind stalagmites allow zero damage ranged training.

overview: Drops Big bones and Mossy keys for Bryophyta. Susceptible to slash weapons and fire magic.

methods.title: Fast Slash Melee
methods.whyThisWorks: Moss Giants have very low slash defence (+0). 4-tick Dragon scimitar delivers max kills/hr.

overview: High-hitpoint giant dropping Rune scimitars and Ancient shards. Often fought via halberd or ranged safespots.

methods.title: Melee Slayer Setup
methods.whyThisWorks: High damage potential of Fire Giants is completely negated by Protect from Melee.

methods.title: Safespot Ranged (Catacombs)
methods.whyThisWorks: Safespots behind pillars in Waterfall Dungeon or Catacombs allow zero-supply kills.

overview: Demonic creature vulnerable to demonbane weaponry like Arclight and Silverlight.

methods.title: Arclight Demon Slaying
methods.whyThisWorks: Arclight gains +70% accuracy and +30% damage against all demon class monsters.

overview: Staple Slayer task. Highly vulnerable to demonbane equipment.

methods.title: Demonbane Melee
methods.whyThisWorks: Proselyte prayer gear maximizes prayer efficiency with Arclight's overwhelming damage.

overview: Heavy-hitting demonic monster. Protect from Melee is mandatory in melee combat.

methods.title: Arclight Prayer Camp
methods.whyThisWorks: Emberlight obliterates Black Demons with +70% accuracy and +36% damage multipliers.

overview: Bloodvelds attack with Melee that rolls against the player's Magic Defence! Wear high magic defence gear or pray Melee.
weaknesses: Thicc body vulnerable to Venator bow ricochet

methods.title: Proselyte Piety Melee
methods.whyThisWorks: Protect from Melee blocks 100% of their magic-based melee damage, allowing unlimited aggression.

methods.title: Venator Bow Multikill (Catacombs)
methods.whyThisWorks: Black d'hide provides huge natural magic defence while Bowfa hits through their defence rapidly.

overview: Facemask or Slayer helmet is MANDATORY; without it, combat stats drain to 0 in seconds. Premier Ancient Magicks barrage task.
protectionAndSurvival: Slayer helmet (i) or Facemask required to avoid deadly blinding smoke

methods.title: Ancient Magicks Barrage (Catacombs)
methods.whyThisWorks: Stacking Dust Devils with darts and casting Ice Barrage yields over 150,000 Magic XP and 80,000 Slayer XP/hr.

methods.title: Budget Ice Burst Setup
methods.whyThisWorks: Ancient sceptre gives +10% Ancient spell accuracy and effect bonus on a budget.

overview: Stone winged creature. Heavy crush weakness. Rock hammer or Granite hammer MANDATORY to deliver death blow at 9 HP.

methods.title: Crush Weaponry (Abyssal Bludgeon)
methods.whyThisWorks: Gargoyles possess a severe crush weakness. Fast 4-tick crush weapons crush their stone skin effortlessly.

methods.title: Budget Dragon Mace Crush
methods.whyThisWorks: Dragon mace provides reliable 4-tick crush attack on a budget under 100k GP.

overview: MANDATORY MECHANIC: Completely immune to all damage EXCEPT Leaf-bladed weapons (Sword, Battleaxe, Spear), Broad bolts, Broad arrows, and Magic Dart!
protectionAndSurvival: Leaf-bladed battleaxe / sword is strictly required; other weapons deal 0 damage

methods.title: Leaf-bladed Battleaxe Melee
methods.whyThisWorks: Leaf-bladed battleaxe has a massive +92 Melee Strength and penetrates Kurask immunity cleanly.

methods.title: Ranged Safespot (Broad Bolts)
methods.whyThisWorks: Broad bolts bypass Kurask immunity while safe-spotted behind rocks.

overview: Spawns vicious Chauldren Death Spawns. Catacombs variant is the premier Ice Barrage task in OSRS.

methods.title: Ancient Magicks Barrage (Catacombs)
methods.whyThisWorks: Death spawns grant extra blood rune and rune drops when bursting groups in Catacombs.

overview: Teleporting creature that drops the Abyssal whip. Demonic classification grants huge vulnerability to Arclight.

methods.title: Ice Barrage Bursting (Catacombs)
methods.whyThisWorks: Stacking and barrage-bursting clears entire rooms in minutes with ash sanctifier.

methods.title: Emberlight / Arclight Melee
methods.whyThisWorks: Demonic classification makes Emberlight hit with devastating accuracy.

overview: MANDATORY: Must equip an Elemental shield, Mind shield, Dragonfire shield, or Ancient wyvern shield to prevent fatal icy breath!
protectionAndSurvival: Never use 2H weapons; shield is strictly required to survive breath

methods.title: Safespot Crossbow Ranged
methods.whyThisWorks: Dragon hunter crossbow grants +30% accuracy and damage while Dragonfire ward negates icy breath.

methods.title: Dragon Hunter Lance Melee
methods.whyThisWorks: Dragon hunter lance shreds wyverns with +20% damage while DFS blocks icy breath completely.

overview: MANDATORY: Immune to all weapons EXCEPT Leaf-bladed weapons, Broad bolts, Broad arrows, and Magic Dart!

methods.title: Leaf-bladed Sword Melee
methods.whyThisWorks: Leaf-bladed sword has 4-tick speed, bypassing immunity effortlessly.

overview: MANDATORY: Must equip a Mirror shield or V's shield to prevent stone-gaze stat drain.

methods.title: Mirror Shield Melee
methods.whyThisWorks: Mirror shield completely reflects the petrifying gaze.

overview: MANDATORY: Must equip a Mirror shield or V's shield! Drops the Basilisk jaw to create the Neitiznot faceguard. Severe crush weakness.
protectionAndSurvival: V's shield offers superior stats; mirror shield is budget fallback

methods.title: Crush Weapon (V's Shield)
methods.whyThisWorks: V's shield blocks the gaze while Fang's double accuracy roll punches through their high defence.

methods.title: Dragon Mace & Mirror Shield
methods.whyThisWorks: Dragon mace exploits their -20 crush defence on a low budget.

overview: MANDATORY: Must wear Boots of stone or Boots of brimstone to walk on the caustic volcanic floor! Dragonbane weapons highly effective.
specialEquipmentAdvantage: Boots of stone or Boots of brimstone (MANDATORY)
protectionAndSurvival: Floor burns dealing rapid 4-10 damage without boots of stone

methods.title: Dragon Hunter Crossbow
methods.whyThisWorks: DHCB melts Drakes with +30% dragonbane multiplier while Boots of stone protect from floor burn.

overview: MANDATORY: Boots of stone or Boots of brimstone required. Vulnerable to dragonbane weapons and stab.

methods.title: Dragon Hunter Lance Melee
methods.whyThisWorks: Lance delivers fast +20% dragonbane stab hits.

overview: MANDATORY: Boots of stone required. Normal Slayer monster precursor to Alchemical Hydra. Poison breath.

methods.title: Blowpipe & Dragonbane
methods.whyThisWorks: Blowpipe rapid-fires through low defence with Boots of stone protecting from caustic heat.

overview: MANDATORY: Insulated boots required to survive lightning attack! Dragon hunter lance and Dragonfire shield recommended.
protectionAndSurvival: Insulated boots reduce electricity damage from 20+ to 1-2

methods.title: Dragon Hunter Lance & DFS
methods.whyThisWorks: Insulated boots nullify lightning orbs while DHL + DFS provides immense stab and dragonfire immunity.

overview: Superior variant of Gargoyle. Fires a falling stone ball that must be dodged. Crush weapon and Rock hammer required.

methods.title: Crush Bludgeon Smash
methods.whyThisWorks: Dodge 1 tile when it flings the stone ball, then finish with rock hammer.

overview: Superior variant of Abyssal demon. Heavy melee hits. Protect from Melee mandatory.

methods.title: Emberlight Demonbane
methods.whyThisWorks: Emberlight bypasses its high superior defence with +70% accuracy.

overview: Guards of the palace. Attack one and others gang up in multi-combat.

methods.title: Scimitar Training
methods.whyThisWorks: Fast scimitar clearing with high slash accuracy.

overview: Vulnerable to Fire Magic with a 100% elemental damage weakness!

methods.title: Fire Spells (100% Weakness)
methods.whyThisWorks: Fire spells deal double (+100%) damage due to elemental weakness.

overview: Large targets popular for cannon and ranged training at the Combat Training Camp.

methods.title: Safespot Ranged / Cannon
methods.whyThisWorks: High HP and low defence makes them ideal for rapid ranged XP.

overview: Has 1 in all defensive stats and 60 HP. The premier AFK training monster in Old School RuneScape.
weaknesses: Zero defence; all combat styles excel

methods.title: AFK Max Strength Melee
methods.whyThisWorks: Zero defence means pure strength bonus gives maximum possible XP per hour.

overview: High-tier revenant. Wilderness weapons (Craw's bow / Webweaver) grant +50% accuracy and +50% damage. Salve amulet (ei) stacks!

methods.title: Craw's Bow / Webweaver
methods.whyThisWorks: Wilderness weapon +50% multiplier stacks multiplicatively with Salve amulet (ei) (+20%), giving over 15 DPS.

overview: MANDATORY: Anti-dragon shield or Dragonfire shield required to survive dragonfire.

methods.title: Anti-Dragon Shield Melee
methods.whyThisWorks: Dragon sword provides fast 4-tick stab hits while Anti-dragon shield negates breath.

overview: IMMUNITY TRICK: Protect from Magic + Extended antifire provides 100% COMPLETE IMMUNITY to all dragonfire and ranged magic attacks!

methods.title: Dragon Hunter Crossbow (Zero Damage)
methods.whyThisWorks: Praying Magic with Antifire renders player completely invulnerable; DHCB provides +30% boost.

overview: Undead skeleton champion. Severe crush weakness. Salve amulet (ei) stacks with Wilderness weapon (Ursine/Viggora)!

methods.title: Crush Mace & Salve (ei)
methods.whyThisWorks: Ursine chainmace (+50%) combined with Salve (ei) (+20%) and Mythical cape (+6 crush) melts Calvar'ion in seconds.

methods.title: Dragon Mace & Salve (e)
methods.whyThisWorks: Low risk budget setup: only protect Dragon mace, Dragon defender, and Mythical cape on death.

overview: Wilderness spider boss. Severe crush weakness. Avoid white web shooting and green acid pools.

methods.title: Ursine Chainmace Crush
methods.whyThisWorks: Crush weapon shreds her negative crush defence while high magic defence gear mitigates magic spiderlings.

overview: Wilderness bear boss. Can be frozen with Entangle or Ice Barrage and easily kited around traps with Ranged.

methods.title: Webweaver Bow Freezing
methods.whyThisWorks: Webweaver bow's special attack freezes Artio for 20 seconds while dealing rapid damage.

overview: Multi-combat variant of Artio. Webweaver bow with freeze barrage kiting.

methods.title: Webweaver Bow Team / Solo
methods.whyThisWorks: Wilderness bow bonus is mandatory to punch through Callisto's massive defence.

overview: Multi-combat spider queen. Craw's bow or Webweaver bow rapid fire while dodging web attacks.

methods.title: Webweaver Bow Ranged
methods.whyThisWorks: Ranged attacks safely out-range her melee smashes while Webweaver deals massive DPS.

overview: Multi-combat undead skeleton boss. Salve amulet (ei) + Ursine chainmace + Crush strictly recommended.

methods.title: Ursine Chainmace & Salve (ei)
methods.whyThisWorks: Multiplicative stacking of Ursine (+50%) and Salve (ei) (+20%) decimates both Vet'ion phases.

overview: INVENTORY TRICK: Disarming attack un-equips gear if inventory has space! Fill all 28 inventory slots with cheap stews/pies so it can never disarm you!

methods.title: Craw's Bow & Full Stew Inventory
methods.whyThisWorks: Keeping 28 items in inventory prevents the green disarming projectile from ever removing your weapon.

overview: Rat boss teaching PvM overhead prayers. Ratbane weapons (Bone mace, Bone shortbow, Bone staff) deal a MASSIVE +10 flat max hit!

methods.title: Bone Mace Crush (Ratbane BiS)
methods.whyThisWorks: Crush weakness combined with fast 4-tick speed kills Scurrius in under 45 seconds.

overview: Undead dragon boss. Dragonbane weapons and Salve amulet (ei) (+20%) stack multiplicatively. Dragonfire ward/shield mandatory.
specialEquipmentAdvantage: Dragon hunter weapons (+30% DHCB / +20% Lance advantage)

combatMechanics.name: Acid Pools & Rapid Fireball
combatMechanics.description: Vorkath spews pools of acid across the arena and fires rapid fireballs at the player.
combatMechanics.avoidanceTip: Walk continuously without stopping (Woox walk) to avoid fireball explosions.

combatMechanics.name: Zombified Spawn (Freeze)
combatMechanics.description: Vorkath freezes the player and launches an exploding zombified spawn.
combatMechanics.avoidanceTip: Cast Crumble Undead immediately on the spawn to kill it in one hit.

combatMechanics.name: Vertical Fireball (One-shot)
combatMechanics.description: A slow-moving vertical fireball dealing lethal damage if standing on target tile.
combatMechanics.avoidanceTip: Step at least two tiles away immediately upon seeing it launch.

combatMechanics.name: Prayer Disabling Dragonfire
combatMechanics.description: A pink flame projectile that disables active protection prayers.
combatMechanics.avoidanceTip: Re-enable Protect from Missiles or Protect from Magic instantly.

methods.title: Dragon Hunter Crossbow (BiS Ranged)
methods.whyThisWorks: Dragon Hunter Crossbow (+30%), Salve (ei) (+20%), and Elite Void (+12.5%) stack to produce the highest consistent DPS in the game at Vorkath.

methods.title: Dragon Hunter Lance (BiS Melee)
methods.whyThisWorks: Dragon Hunter Lance requires zero ammunition cost and permits effortless Woox walking during the acid pool phase.

methods.title: Budget Rune Crossbow Setup
methods.whyThisWorks: Accessible setup capable of securing the Vorkath's head drop on 50th kill.

overview: Solo poison serpent that rotates between Green (Ranged), Blue (Magic), and Red (Melee) phases. Anti-venom+ mandatory.
weaknesses: Magic against Red & Green phases (Trident / Tumeken's shadow)
Ranged against Blue phase (Bow of faerdhinen / Blowpipe)

methods.title: Bow of Faerdhinen (No Switch Method)
methods.whyThisWorks: Bow of faerdhinen has such extreme accuracy that it hits cleanly through Zulrah's Green, Red, AND Blue phases without needing gear switches.

methods.title: Mage/Range Hybrid (Trident + Blowpipe)
methods.whyThisWorks: Classic hybrid rotation: cast powered staff on Green/Red phases, switch to Toxic blowpipe on Blue phase.

overview: MANDATORY MECHANIC: Corporeal Beast reduces ALL damage from non-spear weapons by 50%! Zamorakian spear is strictly mandatory for main DPS. Spec lowering with DWH, BGS, and Arclight allows solo kills.

methods.title: Zamorakian Spear & Spec Lowering
methods.whyThisWorks: Zamorakian spear is the only weapon that avoids Corp's 50% damage reduction penalty. Spec down with 3 DWH, 20 Arclight, 200 BGS damage.

overview: MANDATORY MECHANIC: Kree'arra CANNOT be attacked with Melee! Melee attacks always fail. Must be fought with Ranged (Chinchompas on minion or Bowfa) or Magic (Shadow).

methods.title: Black Chinchompa Minion Method
methods.whyThisWorks: Targeting the melee minion with Black chinchompas rolls accuracy against the minion's low defence and splashes onto Kree'arra for massive hits.

methods.title: Bow of Faerdhinen Step-Under
methods.whyThisWorks: Step-under method with Bowfa prevents Kree'arra's devastating melee slam attack.

overview: Guardian of the Fire Cape. Attacks with lethal 97-damage Ranged and Magic blasts. Must switch prayers based on audio and visual telegraphs.

methods.title: Toxic Blowpipe & Bowfa
methods.overheadPrayer: Overhead Prayer Reaction (Mage slam / Ranged stomp)
methods.whyThisWorks: Blowpipe shreds Yt-HurKot healers while high prayer bonus from Blessed d'hide sustains overheads throughout the 63 waves.

overview: MANDATORY MECHANIC: Kraken is 100% IMMUNE to all Melee and Ranged attacks! Magic only. Drops the Trident of the seas and Kraken tentacle.
weaknesses: Magic (Trident of the swamp / Tumeken's shadow)
specialEquipmentAdvantage: Trident of the swamp / Trident of the seas (MANDATORY)

methods.title: Trident of the Swamp & High Magic Def
methods.whyThisWorks: Kraken rolls magic damage against player magic defence. High magic gear combined with powered staff yields fast, relaxed kills.

overview: Bandos champion. Bowfa 6:0 kiting method allows 30-50 kill trips without taking any melee damage.

methods.title: Bow of Faerdhinen (6:0 Door-Altar Method)
methods.whyThisWorks: The 6:0 kiting loop between the altar and boss door never lets Graardor enter melee range, resulting in 0 melee damage taken.

methods.title: Melee Tank & Fang
methods.whyThisWorks: Osmumten's fang double accuracy roll punches through Graardor's 250 slash/stab defence.

overview: Spider queen with a SEVERE crush weakness (-25). Casts web binds that freeze the player. Protect from Melee is mandatory.
specialEquipmentAdvantage: Crush weapons (Sarachnis cudgel / Inquisitor mace / Dragon mace)

methods.title: Crush Weapon (Sarachnis Cudgel / Inquisitor)
methods.whyThisWorks: Crush attack bonus exploits her -25 crush defence penalty, hitting max damage constantly.

overview: Zamorakian greater demon. Attacks with Yarrr! prayer smash if player stays in melee. Scorching bow or Bowfa 8:0 avoids melee hits completely.

methods.title: Bow of Faerdhinen (8:0 Loop)
methods.whyThisWorks: 8:0 running loop prevents K'ril from ever catching up to melee distance, avoiding his deadly 49-damage prayer smash.

methods.title: Emberlight / Arclight Melee
methods.whyThisWorks: Emberlight deals colossal demonbane damage when running step-under hits.

overview: Saradomin commander with lightning speed. Never fight her in melee range! Kited continuously around room perimeter with Bowfa or Shadow.

methods.title: Bow of Faerdhinen Perimeter Kiting
methods.whyThisWorks: BofA provides 10-tile range, allowing uninterrupted shooting while sprinting along the walls with Stamina potions.

overview: MANDATORY: Falador shield 3 or 4 indicates mole location on map after burrowing; light source required. Dharok's set at 1 HP deals up to 100+ damage hits.

methods.title: Dharok's 1 HP Greataxe (Max DPS)
methods.whyThisWorks: Lowering HP to 1 with locator orb doubles Dharok's damage, hitting 90-100+ on every swing.

overview: MANDATORY TRIBRID ROTATION: Rex is immune to Range/Melee (use Magic); Prime is immune to Melee/Magic (use Ranged); Supreme is immune to Magic/Range (use Melee).

methods.title: Full Tribrid (Rex/Prime/Supreme)
methods.whyThisWorks: Tribrid inventory rotation: Cast Trident on Rex, shoot Blowpipe at Prime, slash Supreme with Fang/Whip.

overview: MANDATORY: 5 brothers have 0 Magic defence (Ahrim is the sole exception). Trident or Iban Blast melts Dharok, Verac, Torag, Guthan, and Karil.
weaknesses: Magic (Trident of the swamp / Iban Blast)

methods.title: Trident of the Swamp & Blowpipe
methods.whyThisWorks: Powered staff casts ignore barrows armour; Toxic blowpipe switch shreds Ahrim.

overview: MANDATORY: Spectral spirit shield reduces Summoned Soul prayer drain by 50% (from 30 to 15 per ghost). Demonic classification: Emberlight / Arclight is supreme.
specialEquipmentAdvantage: Spectral spirit shield (halves ghost prayer drain)

methods.title: Emberlight & Spectral Spirit Shield
methods.whyThisWorks: Emberlight bypasses Cerberus's high defence with +70% accuracy; switch to Spectral shield when ghosts summon.

overview: MANDATORY: Boots of stone required. Lure Hydra onto colored chemical vents (Poison -> Red, Lightning -> Green, Flame -> Blue) to strip its 75% damage reduction.

methods.title: Dragon Hunter Crossbow (Vent Luring)
methods.whyThisWorks: DHCB dragonbane bonus (+30%) melts through its 1100 HP once chemical vents remove its protective shield.

overview: MANDATORY: Rock hammer or Granite hammer required. Melee on Dawn (crush weak); Ranged on Dusk (blowpipe shred).

methods.title: Hybrid Melee / Ranged (Blowpipe & Cudgel)
methods.whyThisWorks: Sarachnis cudgel crushes Dawn's stone body; switch to Toxic blowpipe for Dusk.

overview: NOT UNDEAD: Salve amulet DOES NOT WORK! Wake Duke by brewing Arder and Musca potions. Slash attacks (Soulreaper axe, Scythe, Fang) are premier.

methods.title: Soulreaper Axe / Scythe of Vitur
methods.whyThisWorks: Soulreaper axe builds up to +40 flat strength while Duke's 3x3 hitbox and -15 slash defence guarantees massive DPS.

overview: Frenzied executioner boss. Slash weapons only! Step between swinging blood axes and shoot strangler tentacles.

methods.title: Blade of Saeldor & Blood Fury
methods.whyThisWorks: Blade of saeldor combined with Bellator ring (+20 slash) and Blood fury sustains HP against his rapid bleeding attacks.

overview: MANDATORY MECHANIC: Completely IMMUNE to Melee and Ranged! Magic only. Tumeken's shadow or Sanguinesti staff with Sanity potion management.

methods.title: Tumeken's Shadow (Sanity Management)
methods.whyThisWorks: Tumeken's shadow triples magic damage and accuracy, delivering 12+ DPS while running the L-shaped arena loop.

overview: Deep trench serpent that speeds up attack rate to 1 tick. Stun with Shadow spell to reset speed.
weaknesses: Ranged (Webweaver bow / Bow of faerdhinen / ZCB)

methods.title: Webweaver Bow & Shadow Stun
methods.whyThisWorks: Webweaver bow's special attack unloads 4 rapid hits into Leviathan's vulnerable back.

overview: Ancient Zarosian general. Zaryte crossbow with Ruby dragon bolts (e) and Osmumten's fang. Avoid cough contagion.

methods.title: Zaryte Crossbow & Osmumten's Fang
methods.whyThisWorks: ZCB spec procs 110-damage Ruby bolt hits guaranteed while Masori armour repels blood reavers.

overview: MANDATORY PHASE IMMUNITY: Phase 1 prays Protect from Magic and Missiles (use Melee / Keris / Verac); Phase 2 prays Protect from Melee (use Ranged / Bowfa / Blowpipe).

methods.title: Keris Partisan P1 & Bowfa P2
methods.whyThisWorks: Keris / Crush penetrates Phase 1; switch to Bow of faerdhinen to bypass Phase 2 melee prayer.

overview: Cast Shadow spells (Shadow Blitz/Barrage) to stun Sire and destroy respiratory vents. Arclight/Emberlight shreds Sire once stunned.

methods.title: Shadow Spells & Emberlight
methods.whyThisWorks: Shadow Blitz guarantees disorienting Sire while Emberlight deals +70% accuracy against demonbane body.

overview: No outside items allowed! Craft Tier 3 Corrupted Bow and Staff. Switch overhead prayers every 4 attacks from the Corrupted Hunllef.

methods.title: T3 Perfected Weapons & T1 Armour
methods.whyThisWorks: Tier 3 Bow and Staff with 3 potions and full fish allows fast 8-minute corrupted clears.

overview: Raid with custom invocations (0-500+). Osmumten's fang is supreme on Kephri, Ba-ba, and Wardens.

methods.title: Osmumten's Fang & Shadow (Expert 400+)
methods.whyThisWorks: Fang's double accuracy roll makes it the unrivaled king of high invocation ToA.

overview: First OSRS raid. DWH spec on bosses, Dragon hunter lance on Olm's melee hand, Blowpipe/Bowfa on head.

methods.title: Dragon Hunter Lance & Twisted Bow
methods.whyThisWorks: Dragon hunter lance shreds Olm's melee hand while DWH defense drain speeds up every room.

overview: Intense combat raid. Scythe of vitur is supreme on Maiden, Bloat, Soti, Xarpus, and Verzik.

methods.title: Scythe of Vitur & Blade of Saeldor
methods.whyThisWorks: Every ToB boss is large (2x2 to 5x5), granting the Scythe 3 distinct hits per attack for unrivaled 18+ DPS.

overview: MANDATORY: Facemask or Slayer helmet required. Fang or Scythe with POH rejuvenation pool redemption method.

methods.title: Osmumten's Fang (POH Redemption)
methods.whyThisWorks: Fang kills Thermy in 4-5 hits while POH pool teleports reset all damage instantly.

overview: Demon boss summoned with Dark Totem. Arclight or Emberlight 100% ONE-SHOTS awakened altars and deals massive demonbane damage.

methods.title: Arclight / Emberlight Demonbane
methods.whyThisWorks: Arclight always destroys his protective corner altars in exactly 1 hit and decimates his demonic HP.

overview: Ancient forge master in CoX. Severe crush weakness. Elder maul or Dragon warhammer defence drain mandatory.

methods.title: Elder Maul & Inquisitor Crush
methods.whyThisWorks: Elder maul specials strip 35% defence while crush hits stagger Tekton between anvils.

overview: Final dragon boss of CoX. Mage hand (Shadow/Trident), Melee hand (Dragon hunter lance), Head phase (Twisted bow / Bowfa).

methods.title: Lance & Shadow Olm Rotation
methods.whyThisWorks: Dragon hunter lance gives +20% dragonbane bonus against both the Melee hand and Head.

overview: Scarab queen. Keris partisan of breaching deals +33% damage against scarabs and triggers 3x piercing special attacks.

methods.title: Keris Partisan of Breaching
methods.whyThisWorks: Scarabbane weapon combined with crush blows bypasses her thick chitin armor effortlessly.

locations: Wilderness (Lair of the King Black Dragon)
overview: MANDATORY: Dragonfire shield + Antifire potion mandatory to avoid fiery breath. Dragon hunter lance / Crossbow shreds him.

methods.title: Dragon Hunter Lance & DFS
methods.whyThisWorks: Lance's dragonbane multiplier paired with DFS grants complete dragonfire immunity and rapid 40+ damage hits.

overview: Ancient Zarosian monster. Bowfa for running and DPS; Sapphire dragon bolts (e) mandatory to smite the Soul Shield phase.
weaknesses: Sapphire dragon bolts (e) on shield phase
Bow of faerdhinen on ranged phase
Ice Barrage freezes on melee phase

methods.title: Bowfa & Sapphire Bolts Smite
methods.whyThisWorks: Bow of faerdhinen accurately hits Muspah; Sapphire dragon bolts (e) with Smite shatters its shield phase in seconds.
